answer: Agents can earn access to shared jobs only after posting a bond in a scarce on-chain token, then receive small payments for verifiable work over time. A newcomer cannot cheaply multiply identities: each sybil must lock its own bond, and misconduct burns it. The bond does not prove a person is unique, but it makes fake identities costly and ties repeated abuse to capital at risk, whether the work concerns shale, tundra, or a summit.
